events.title: DrupalCon Chicago 2026
events.content:
DrupalCon Chicago 2026 brings together web professionals, open-source contributors, and digital leaders at the Hilton Chicago for four days of professional training, sector-focused summits, deep dive sessions, workshops, and hands-on contribution opportunities.

Talk Commerce is an official media partner at the event. Isaac Morey will be on the ground conducting interviews with agencies, technology providers, and community leaders who are driving the future of Drupal and the open web. Whether you are shipping a new module, leading an agency, or shaping the Drupal roadmap, we want to capture your story.

It is a rare opportunity to deepen your open-source skills, network with thought leaders, and contribute to the future of the open web. All in Chicago, a world-class city with iconic architecture, a thriving food scene, and a rich cultural tapestry along the shores of Lake Michigan.

What to Expect

Professional Training

Hands-on training options to level up your Drupal and open-source skills.

Sector-Focused Summits

Deep dives into industry-specific challenges and solutions on the Drupal platform.

Sessions and Workshops

Expert-led deep dive sessions and interactive workshops across every skill level.

Contribution Opportunities

Give back to the Drupal community with hands-on contribution sprints and mentoring.

events.title: Meet Magento Florida 2026
events.content:
Workshop Agenda

This 90-minute interactive workshop guides Magento merchants through the evolution of search from keyword-driven SEO to AI-powered discovery and provides a practical roadmap for boosting product and content visibility across today's modern search experiences.

Attendees learned why traditional SEO is no longer enough, how search has shifted toward answers, generative summaries, and AI overviews, and how to optimize their stores using a unified AEO, GEO, and AIO framework. The session covered structured data, schema markup, answer-ready product content, FAQs, Q&A modules, and techniques for creating authoritative, citation-worthy guides and category content that AI engines trust.

The workshop also explored preparing Magento stores for Google's AI Overviews, strengthening E-E-A-T signals, implementing essential extensions, improving site structure and speed, and leveraging internal linking for topical authority. The session concluded with a 30-day implementation plan covering auditing, schema setup, content creation, and performance tracking.

Key Takeaways

A Unified Search Optimization Framework

AEO + GEO + AIO strategy to future-proof Magento visibility across AI-driven search.

AI-Ready Product Content Techniques

Schema markup, FAQs, Q&A modules, and Magento enhancements that drive snippets and citations.

Blueprint for Citation-Ready Authority

Guides, comparisons, and content structures AI engines trust and reference.

AI Overview Optimization Strategy

How to prepare Magento stores so Google's AI Overviews pull accurate, conversion-ready information.

Technical Essentials for Modern Search

Recommended extensions, site structure improvements, internal linking strategy, and speed best practices.

A Complete 30-Day Implementation Plan

Audit, Schema, Content, Monitoring, with clear action steps.

Target Audience

  • eCommerce and Magento Merchants looking to future-proof their SEO and adapt to AI-driven search
  • Digital Marketing Managers and Growth Leaders responsible for organic visibility and content performance
  • SEO Specialists and Content Teams creating product, category, FAQ, and buying-guide content for improved AI discovery
  • Technical Stakeholders such as developers, TPMs, TAMs, and architects who manage schema, site performance, and crawlability
  • Solution Integrators and Consultants working with Magento merchants on search, content, and commerce optimization
  • Agencies seeking to implement unified AEO + GEO + AIO strategies for clients
  • Sales and Digital Marketing Professionals aiming to leverage AI-powered search improvements for revenue growth

events.title: The Running Event 2026
events.content:
Talk Commerce is heading to The Running Event 2026, December 1 to 3 at the Henry B. Gonzalez Convention Center in San Antonio. Brent Peterson and Isaac Morey will be recording interviews with the people building running brands and the stores and platforms that sell them.

One interview becomes months of content. Talk Commerce records a professional podcast interview with your team at the show, and Content Cucumber's 40+ writers turn the conversation into blog articles, social clips, case studies, and SEO content. We take a limited number of interviews at each event, and paid interviews are booked first.

Interview Packages

Each package includes a professional on-camera interview. We bring the gear and guide the conversation. The higher packages add written content from the Content Cucumber team.

Free Spotlight

A quick, professional interview that introduces your brand to the Talk Commerce podcast audience.

  • 3-minute guided interview at the show
  • Professional camera and audio
  • Published on the Talk Commerce podcast
  • Shareable video clip for your channels

Deep Dive, $200

A full-length conversation. Tell your story, explain your product, and share your perspective on the running industry.

  • 15-minute in-depth interview
  • Published as a full podcast episode
  • Multiple edited clips for social media
  • B-roll footage of your booth included
  • Raw footage delivered to your team

Full Content Package, custom pricing

Talk Commerce records and Content Cucumber writes. One interview becomes a complete content library for your marketing team. It includes everything in the Deep Dive, plus the following.

  • Case study written by Content Cucumber
  • SEO-optimized blog article
  • Social media content calendar with clips
  • Post-event email campaign assets
  • Content distribution support

How It Works

Pick Your Package

Choose the Spotlight (free), the Deep Dive ($200), or the Full Content Package (custom). Fill out the form below and we will confirm your slot.

We Come to Your Booth

Talk Commerce shows up with professional gear and guides a natural, relaxed conversation, without scripts or teleprompters. Your team talks about what they already know.

Content Delivered

Talk Commerce edits and publishes the episode. For the Full Content Package, Content Cucumber's writers produce blog articles, case studies, and social content from the interview.

Common Questions

What if our team is not comfortable on camera?

That is why we guide the conversation. We ask questions your team already knows the answers to and keep the tone relaxed. We have done hundreds of these.

When will we receive the final content?

Video clips and published episodes arrive within two weeks. Written content such as blog articles and case studies arrives within three weeks. Rush delivery is available.

Can we use the footage for our own marketing?

Yes. You receive the clips, the raw footage, and full permission to use them on your social channels, website, email campaigns, and sales decks. It is your content.

What are Talk Commerce and Content Cucumber?

Talk Commerce is a podcast and media platform with 500+ episodes focused on ecommerce. Content Cucumber is a content creation agency with 40+ human writers. Talk Commerce records the interview and Content Cucumber turns it into written content. One conversation becomes a full marketing library.

Book a time below and we will confirm the details.
